verdict.rationale: Modal is a programmable compute platform, so a natural-language operating interface is a fair axis. The evidence shows only an official skill that helps third-party coding agents use Modal, plus an llms.txt file. These are enablers for external agents, not a natural-language command interface built into Modal itself. The product's documented interfaces are SDKs and a conventional CLI.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
